figures.claim: 1. Figure 1: Overview of the CUSUM-calibrated rollback controller. Both Or-ϵ (top pathway) and CUSUM-ϵ (bottom pathway) use the same probe loss measurement and innovation signal, but differ in their decision rules: Or-ϵ triggers rollback when innovation exceeds threshold ϵ, while CUSUM-ϵ accumulates evidence via statistic St and triggers when St > h. Both are calibrated to the same nominal rollback rate p0 = 0.2%. The FIR partial reset (St ← h/2 after rollback) addresses the reset blind spot in standard CUSUM.
figures.explanation: Analysis stage: The repository implements the shared probe-loss / innovation pipeline in a common training loop, with OrController using a one-step threshold and CUSUMController using S_t accumulation and FIR reset.
